skill.name: marketing-mindset
skill.description: Applies an opinionated B2B marketing mindset to early customer acquisition, positioning, outreach, copy, and short-cycle growth decisions.
skill.summary: Turn an early-stage marketing question into a focused, testable customer-acquisition plan.
skill.author: Axel Freeman (axelfreeman)

security_audit.summary: All 27 static findings are false positives: the command detections are Markdown references to a benign local gate script, and the reconnaissance detections are ordinary marketing prose. Semantic review found unsafe identity, autonomous-action, and misleading persuasion instructions that should be revised before publication.

remediation.issue: The skill presents the assistant as a named live human with asserted professional credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Describe the desired communication style without claiming a human identity, personal history, or credentials the assistant cannot verify.

remediation.issue: The skill directs broad repository access and continuous advertising automation without explicit confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Require user approval before reading additional project data, publishing content, launching ads, spending funds, or changing connected services.

remediation.issue: Several passages encourage exaggeration and emotional manipulation despite separate anti-fraud language.
remediation.suggestion: Require factual, substantiated claims and prohibit exploiting fear, anxiety, or material omissions in marketing content.

content.user_title: Build a Practical First-Customer Marketing Plan
content.value_statement: Early-stage teams often lack a clear path from product idea to first customers. This skill turns limited evidence into focused positioning and acquisition tests.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates marketing ideas against a three-month outcome and a fast test.
Builds first-client plans that begin with founder use and manual outreach.
Compares active competitors by audience, channel, positioning, and growth stage.
Rewrites basic product descriptions into stronger positioning and campaign angles.
Proposes cold outreach, ad copy, content tasks, and channel-specific launch steps.
Challenges stale sources, weak proxy metrics, and unsupported case studies.
limitations: Focuses on the first ten clients; later-stage scaling is outside its scope.
Provides strategic guidance, not a complete implementation guide for advertising platforms.
Depends on current competitor and audience evidence supplied or researched.
Its rigid rules may not suit regulated, consumer, or relationship-led markets.

use_cases.title: Find a Startup's First Customer
use_cases.description: Create a three-month plan using founder validation, competitor evidence, and direct outreach.

use_cases.title: Strengthen Product Positioning
use_cases.description: Turn a plain feature description into specific promises and testable campaign angles.

use_cases.title: Challenge a Client Growth Plan
use_cases.description: Review assumptions, reject weak evidence, and identify the fastest useful acquisition test.

prompt_templates.title: Define the First Customer
prompt_templates.prompt: I sell [product] to [audience] and have [customer count] customers. Build a focused plan for winning the next customer within three months.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for initial customer acquisition

prompt_templates.title: Improve Positioning
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this product description for [audience]: [description]. Give three distinct positioning angles and one fast test for each angle.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate an Acquisition Channel
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether [channel] can reach [audience] for [offer]. Use current competitor evidence, state assumptions, and design a low-cost test.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Competitor-Led Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these competitors: [list]. Compare audiences, promises, channels, and weaknesses. Produce a three-month launch plan with milestones and measurable stopping rules.

output_examples.input: I built finance automation software and have no customers.
output_examples.output: First, use the product in your own finance workflow and document one measurable result. Then interview five target operators and test three outreach angles.

output_examples.input: Should I buy search ads before launching?
output: Validate one message through direct conversations before buying traffic.
Review active competitor ads to identify proven language and missing claims.
Run a small search test only after defining conversion and stopping thresholds.

output_examples.input: My homepage says that we provide project management software.
output_examples.output: Lead with a specific audience and outcome: Finish client projects without chasing status updates. Test this promise against speed, visibility, and accountability angles.

best_practices: Provide the audience, current customer count, offer, and available evidence.
Verify competitor claims with recent public sources before using them.
Define success, cost, duration, and stopping rules for every test.
anti_patterns: Do not treat competitor activity as proof that a tactic will work for every market.
Do not publish claims, messages, or ads without review and factual support.
Do not automate outreach or spending without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Is this skill only for B2B companies?
faq.answer: It is designed mainly for B2B and SaaS. Some principles may help other businesses, but recommendations require market-specific validation.

faq.question: Does it create finished advertising campaigns?
faq.answer: It can draft campaign angles, copy, and test plans. Platform setup, compliance review, budgets, and launch approval remain separate tasks.

faq.question: Can it help before the product launches?
faq.answer: Yes. It can test positioning and demand before launch, provided all claims clearly describe planned capabilities.

faq.question: Does it require paid research tools?
faq.answer: No. It prefers recent public evidence and can use connected research tools when the user authorizes them.

faq.question: How current should competitor evidence be?
faq.answer: Use the newest reliable evidence available. Check dates, active campaigns, current pricing, and recent customer feedback.

faq.question: Will it scale acquisition beyond ten customers?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly focuses on the first customer and the first ten customers, not mature growth systems.
